description: Read-only registry for sanitized API request and response examples linked to API Center providers.

collections.purpose: Document sanitized examples for generation and model metadata workflows before any runtime integration.

requestExamples.name: List available models
requestExamples.auth: Uses OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable name only; credential value omitted.

knownRisks: Model availability and limits can change; examples are shape-only.
collections.nextAction: Keep examples cataloged until a project explicitly scopes OpenAI API execution.

collections.purpose: Document repository and pull request request shapes for delivery visibility.

requestExamples.name: Get repository metadata
requestExamples.auth: Uses GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable name only; credential value omitted.

knownRisks: Repository access depends on token scopes and organization policy.
collections.nextAction: Use as catalog reference only; do not add GitHub request execution in V1.4.

collections.purpose: Document bot API request shapes for future messaging workflows.

requestExamples.name: Send message shape
requestExamples.auth: Uses TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable name only; credential value omitted.

knownRisks: Chat identifiers and bot permissions must stay outside this registry.
collections.nextAction: Keep cataloged until a concrete Telegram channel workflow is scoped.

collections.purpose: Document page and database query shapes for workspace context workflows.

requestExamples.name: Query database shape
requestExamples.auth: Uses NOTION_TOKEN environment variable name only; credential value omitted.

knownRisks: Workspace sharing determines readable pages; page identifiers are omitted.
collections.nextAction: Document target workspace boundaries before any request execution is scoped.

collections.purpose: Document shop and listing request shapes for NumberNinjaDesigns commerce workflows.

requestExamples.name: Get shop listings shape
requestExamples.auth: Uses ETSY_API_KEY and ETSY_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable names only; credential values omitted.

knownRisks: Shop identifiers, listing data, and OAuth authorization are outside this registry.
collections.nextAction: Define read-only shop visibility needs before any Etsy request execution.
